mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that supports robust corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without any additional triggering condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% (the 25th percentile of historical data).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% (a threshold indicating a tightening cycle), it signals a shift to restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) relative to their 3-month moving averages indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1.0% from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (a threshold indicating a contraction) signals a weakening in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to their 3-month moving averages signals a weakening real economy with a tight labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and UNRATE decline by more than 1.0% from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized and UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, UNRATE is below 4.5%, and HOUST declines by more than 1.0% from its 3-month moving average.
